window: Inaugural edition — the significant cases of August 2026. From tomorrow, each edition covers the past 24 hours.

stories.headline: Nineteen children, most under eight, taken back from a placement network in northeast India
stories.summary: Police in Arunachal Pradesh recovered 19 children in a coordinated sweep across six towns reported on 25 August, and arrested three women accused of arranging the placements.

stories.headline: Six people recovered in a Texas hill-country sting
stories.summary: The Comal County Sheriff's Office said on 6 August that a trafficking sting north of San Antonio recovered six people and led to six arrests.

stories.headline: Five-day operation across 59 countries identifies 2,070 trafficking victims
stories.summary: Operation Global Chain, run 8–12 June and reported on 6 July, identified 2,070 victims across 59 countries and produced 1,024 arrests, 334 of them for trafficking offences.

stories.headline: Four Nigerian teenagers taken back from a route to Côte d'Ivoire
stories.summary: Police in Cross River State said on 11 August that they had recovered four teenage girls from a trafficking route running to Côte d'Ivoire.
